description:
Analysis code that reproduces the figures and reported numbers of Leshem et al., Long Read RNA Sequencing in Primary Lung Cell Types Reveals Principles of Nonsense-Mediated Decay.

Code only. The data this code runs on are archived separately as the source-data record (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21544336), which also carries the container image nmd_1.2.sif pinning the exact R and Python versions the analyses ran under. Raw sequencing reads are in NCBI GEO under GSE329233 and are not required.

See REPRODUCTION.md for the run order and docs/VERIFIED.md for the per-claim record of what the rebuild reproduces and where it differs.
